title: arrest-ecg-timing: baselines and recording-time matching in ECG prediction of cardiac arrest (Nightingale arrest-ntuh-ecg)
description: Analysis code for a matched case-control re-analysis of the Nightingale Open Science arrest-ntuh-ecg dataset. A published design that predicted cardiac arrest from ECGs recorded up to a year earlier is rebuilt, control ECGs are drawn from the cases' recording window or matched on the recording gap, and a one-dimensional CNN is tested for what it learned: a linear probe with an untrained floor, increments in both directions on a five-run ensemble, AUROC within heart-rate strata, and heart rate recomputed from the raw signal. Data are not included; logs hold aggregate results only. Version 1.3.0 adds scripts 20-28 (stronger waveform comparators, calendar subset, probe, recomputed heart rate, control composition, and one fixed set of 75 CNN runs) and Figure 2 of the current manuscript. Version 1.2.2 adds the logs of 19_berpasangan.py, with design B 30-365 days rerun alone (--hanya-b-30-365) after the full run was stopped for low memory. Version 1.2.1 adds 19_berpasangan.py (paired comparisons of the simple comparators against the CNN, and the A/B window contrast over three seeds) and an updated Figure 2. Version 1.2.0 added scripts 13-18: logistic-regression and heart-rate comparators in all designs, CNN + machine reading, paired comparisons over all matching seeds, the cardiac-history interaction, and Figure 2 of the current manuscript.
